name: upload_dev18_reranker_off
notes: Reranker experiment on the 18-question upload dev set (before the 2 OCR questions were added), reranker off. Saved after the run from its outputs; settings were not snapshotted at run time (see the source run's summary.json for the retriever, top_k and gate it used). Metrics are recomputed from the rows.

per_question.question: During any audit you conducted, were errors ever attributed to the Horizon IT system?
How did the business decide which branches you would visit, and how often a given branch could expect to see you?
When did you first learn that Ms Hall had been prosecuted?
Turning to POL00091046, can you tell us what that document is?
Which football team do you support?
What was your involvement in the Initial Complaint Review and Mediation Scheme?
Was there any right of appeal against a decision to suspend a subpostmaster?
Before 2014, who had the final say on stopping a postmaster from running their branch while a shortfall was looked into?
Did the auditor's own view of what they had found play any part in whether a subpostmaster was suspended?
You refer to POL00088579, the Operators In Service Debt policy. Why did you come to write it?
What do you do with your spare time now that you have retired?
What did you know about Fujitsu's ability to access branch accounts remotely?
Were you given any specific training on Horizon when you joined the Post Office?
How did you come to be brought into the organisation in the first place?
Did you read Deloitte's Project Bramble reports when they were produced?
Can you help us with POL00149601? What was your part in it?
Where do you like to go on holiday?
What was your involvement in the prosecution of Seema Misra?
